lines.text: Israel took the land of the Amorite kings Sihon and Og, from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon.
The LORD made a covenant with Israel at Sinai and spoke face to face out of the fire.
God commanded Israel to keep the Sabbath holy, working six days and resting on the seventh, servants and livestock included.
The LORD spoke the commandments out of the fire to the assembly and wrote them on two bronze tablets.
